notes: Design: 283 intersections first ticketed January-August 2026, 3 matched LPI intersections each (pool 4590), 323683 geolocated crashes January 2023-October 2026. All outcomes, ratio of ratios (95% interval): rear-end proxy 1.327 (1.061-1.650); persons injured or killed 1.038 (0.907-1.192); pedestrians injured or killed 1.289 (1.029-1.637); 'Traffic Control Disregarded' crashes 1.111 (0.722-1.734); all crashes 1.181 (1.081-1.289). Registered placebo (same sites and windows one year earlier, before any camera): rear-end 1.250 (1.052-1.488); injured 1.263 (1.100-1.445); pedestrians 1.357 (1.031-1.749); red-running 0.866 (0.582-1.280); all crashes 1.296 (1.183-1.418). The placebo shows the design producing ratios of 1.25-1.36 where no camera existed. The likely reason is that controls were matched on their pre-window crash counts, so controls with unusually high counts were chosen and then fell (regression to the mean in the controls), while the camera sites, chosen by DOT on other grounds, did not fall in the same way. The design therefore carries a bias of roughly +25% in every outcome, and the registered estimates must be read against the placebo. Excluding the 3 sites near a 2024-26 street improvement project changes little: rear-end 1.301 (1.057-1.616), injured 1.027 (0.904-1.166). EXPLORATORY, not a test (rule 4): the ratio of the 2026 estimate to the placebo estimate, with a joint bootstrap, is rear-end 1.062 (0.797-1.395), persons injured 0.821 (0.672-0.993), pedestrians 0.95 (0.661-1.348), all crashes 0.911 (0.805-1.039). Read this way, the cameras show no clear rise in rear-end crashes and a fall of about 18% in persons injured, but the adjustment was chosen after the data were seen.
notes_referee: Referee reproduced 1.038 (0.907 to 1.192). Unsettled stands. The matching bias works against this prediction: unmatched comparisons (chosen after the data, exploratory) give 0.84 (0.75 to 0.93) and 0.81 (0.70 to 0.92). A successor must be registered on data not yet read, such as the 2027 windows with later-activated sites as controls.
